tasks.label: All Playwright tests (.env.dev)
tasks.command: . ../../../../../.env.dev && export POSTGRES_USER POSTGRES_PASSWORD POSTGRES_DB KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID="$PLAYWRIGHT_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID" KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET="$PLAYWRIGHT_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET" KEYCLOAK_USERNAME="$PLAYWRIGHT_KEYCLOAK_USERNAME" KEYCLOAK_PASSWORD="$PLAYWRIGHT_KEYCLOAK_PASSWORD" && POSTGRES_HOST=localhost POSTGRES_PORT=5442 npx playwright test
